title: Sage on the Stage
lines: Raj brings his pet rat to class.
He has a huge cage up on the stage.
"This is Sage," he said. "He is my rat."
Sage hops from the cage and runs off!
The class jumps up, but Raj is brave.
He calls, "Sage! Sage!" Sage will not stop.
Raj sets a bit of ham on a page.
Sage smells the ham and runs back.
Raj picks him up and shuts the cage.
"That rat and his ham!" said Raj.

questions.ask: What does Raj do first when Sage runs off?
questions.listenFor: He calls Sage by name, but Sage will not stop. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: What finally gets Sage to come back?
questions.listenFor: A bit of ham that Raj sets on a page. If they say "the ham," ask where Raj put it.

questions.ask: Which moment will you draw — Sage running off, or Sage back in his cage?
questions.listenFor: Either. Line four is the run; line nine is the cage. Ask what made them pick that one.
